## What happened

A short description of the bug.

## Command you ran

```
security-scan ...
```

## What you expected

What the command or dashboard should have done.

## What you saw instead

The actual output, error, or dashboard behavior. Paste relevant log lines from `~/.security-observatory/logs/` if you have them.

```
<logs or output here>
```

## Environment

- OS: (e.g., macOS 14.4, Ubuntu 22.04)
- Python version: `python3 --version`
- DëvSec version / commit: `security-scan --version` or commit SHA
- Scanner versions: paste relevant lines from `security-scan doctor`

## Additional context

Anything else that might help — recent changes, related findings, partial-scan markers, or whether the issue is reproducible.
